headline: Customer Onboarding and Implementation | Practice Management and EHR SaaS | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: Four years at Greenway Health, a US ambulatory EHR and practice management company, getting practices set up and running. I onboarded and supported close to 200 client practices: discovery calls, mapping how each practice actually works, configuring their workflows, supporting setup and training the team. I trained 200+ providers, nurses and medical assistants, and turned what clients struggled with into feature requests that shipped. I also launched my own SaaS product, Roovero, and onboard its paying pilot clients myself. MBBS-trained physician.
greenway_bullets: Onboarded and supported close to 200 client practices: discovery, documenting goals and current workflows, configuring practice-specific workflows and widgets, and supporting setup until the practice was running on its own.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on setup, daily workflows and new features.
Managed several practices at once, tracking where each one stood and what it still needed before it could use the system day to day.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests with product teams; many of the features I shaped shipped to clients with positive feedback.
Worked with Support and Product on defects and patient safety issues through the Patient Safety Committee and Functional Advisory Committee.

Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: provider personas, workflow mapping and React prototypes before engineering handoff; presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: discovery calls, onboarding plans, setup and configuration, user training, time to value
managing several accounts at once, Support and Success hand-offs, client communication, onboarding documentation
ambulatory EHR, practice management, scheduling and charting workflows, clinical documentation
React, GitHub, Claude Code, Codex, n8n, LLM APIs
thesis_html: Onboarding is done when the practitioner runs their week in the product without calling us.
facts: Paying pilots on my own SaaS
why_fit: Discovery, setup, configuration and training at each one.
I know how a clinician's day runs and where software slows it down.
Client pain points became features that shipped.
